# Ryan Duguid

Canonical machine index: https://duguid.com.au/llms.txt

Last reviewed 11 September 2026. Page and source-review dates are recorded on the linked pages; this index date does not renew an engine's legal review.

Identical discovery copy: https://duguid.com.au/.well-known/llms.txt

> Ryan Duguid is an accountant based in Newcastle, New South Wales, Australia. He builds open-source computational accounting tools and publishes them at github.com/ryanduguid. Ryan Duguid is a Provisional CA ANZ Member. CA ANZ has not endorsed this site or its tools.

He is distinct from the United States software product executive Ryan Duguid whose LinkedIn URL has no hyphen. This site is a personal index of open-source accounting tools built in Ryan Duguid's own time and on his own equipment. It is not a practice and is not accepting professional engagements through this site. It does not offer tax or BAS agent services and does not accept taxpayer information or client files.

Every page names the primary source it is grounded in: Commonwealth legislation, ATO rulings and rate schedules, or the accounting standard. Calculations use exact decimal arithmetic. Public fixtures and examples use fabricated or synthetic data. Client data stays local, and human review remains mandatory before posting, payment, lodgement, approval, or period lock. Nothing here is tax, legal, or financial advice. Figures are free to cite with attribution and should be verified against current guidance before anyone relies on them.

## Choose a route

- **Profit and cash** (https://duguid.com.au/evaluate/#profit-and-cash): a fictional Newcastle service-business forecast, with a downloadable Excel workbook and synthetic source files. Delaying one $44,000 receipt by 45 days creates a $25,160 daily cash shortfall while quarterly profit before income tax stays $35,957.55. The independent accountant trial is pending; no client outcome or time saving is claimed.
- **Adopt** (https://duguid.com.au/#adopt): use the supported install commands and evaluate tools with fabricated data.
- **Verify** (https://duguid.com.au/evidence/): open Evidence and Assurance for Australian computational accounting tools to inspect identity and credentials; packages, releases and repositories; sources and review dates; data and privacy boundary; security, tests and release evidence; human accountability and refusals; and independent evaluation.

## For AI agents

- [Australian tax tools for AI agents](https://duguid.com.au/tools/australian-tax-ai-agents/): aus-accounting-mcp is a local computational MCP for Payday Super timing and ATO small-business benchmark ratios. It also supports limited, experimental Division 7A loan-term and repayment review, with human review required. It refuses loan formation, s 109R repayment classification, unpaid present entitlements, and distributable surplus. It also runs six bounded tax worksheets and can search a configured local Markdown library. Worksheets exclude HELP, Medicare, and full return preparation; confirm their supported periods and scope. Retrieved excerpts enter the calling assistant's context. It ships no ATO document library and does not fetch rulings from the web. Official MCP registry name: io.github.ryanduguid/aus-accounting.

## Person

- [About Ryan Duguid](https://duguid.com.au/about/): who he is, where he is, credentials, what the tools are grounded in, and how to cite the work. Machine-readable Person data is in the JSON-LD on that page.

## Evaluation packs

- [Evaluations](https://duguid.com.au/evaluate/): index of the three reproducible accounting-tool evaluations, their fabricated inputs, fixed releases, expected results, and limits.
- [Manager review gate evaluation](https://duguid.com.au/evaluate/manager-review-gate/): reproduces the released review-ready-gate/v0.1.3 result for two fabricated BAS packs, including the exact NOT_READY findings, corrected READY result, and human decision boundary.
- [Xero trial balance integrity evaluation](https://duguid.com.au/evaluate/xero-trial-balance-integrity/): reproduces the movement and YTD balance gate with three fabricated CSV fixtures, no Xero tenant credentials or tenant data, and an explicit human review boundary.
- [Payday Super timing evidence evaluation](https://duguid.com.au/evaluate/payday-super-evidence/): reproduces four fabricated evidence-timing outcomes, including at-risk, on-time, and late classifications, with an explicit human decision boundary.
- [Payday Super evidence-pack development workflow](https://duguid.com.au/tools/payday-super/#evidence-pack): unreleased CLI and MCP work combines report.csv, a SHA-256-bound practitioner checklist, exceptions.json and a blank decision-log.md. The pack omits employee identifiers and queues every non-ON_TIME result. The CLI writes a new directory; MCP returns file contents in memory and accepts no paths. Requires the reviewed development checkout; published checker v0.1.3 and uvx aus-accounting-mcp do not include it. No advice, lodgement or ledger writes.

## Reference tables

- [Rates](https://duguid.com.au/rates/): index of the three maintained Australian tax and payroll references, their verification dates, primary sources, and downloadable CSVs where available.
- [Super guarantee rate history](https://duguid.com.au/rates/super-guarantee/): every general SG percentage from 2002-03 to today. The rate has been 12 per cent since 1 July 2025 with no further steps scheduled. From 1 July 2026, payday super changed when contributions must be paid, not how much.
- [Super guarantee rate history CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/super-guarantee/super-guarantee-rates.csv): machine-readable copy of the maintained table.
- [Division 7A benchmark interest rate](https://duguid.com.au/rates/div7a-benchmark-rate/): 8.77 per cent for 2026-27, 8.37 per cent for 2025-26. Section 109N(2) ITAA 1936 ties the rate to the Reserve Bank's indicator lending rate for bank variable housing loans, the last figure published before the income year starts, which is the May figure rather than the June one.
- [Division 7A benchmark interest rate CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/div7a-benchmark-rate/div7a-benchmark-rates.csv): machine-readable copy of the maintained table.
- [Cents per kilometre rate for car expenses](https://duguid.com.au/rates/cents-per-kilometre/): 91 cents for 2026-27, 88 cents for 2024-25 and 2025-26, capped at the first 5,000 business kilometres per car. One rate for every car, whatever the engine size. The 2026 determination sets 91 cents for that income year alone, so it does not carry into 2027-28 the way the 2024 determination's 88 cents carried into 2025-26.
- [Cents per kilometre rate CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/cents-per-kilometre/cents-per-kilometre-rates.csv): machine-readable copy of the maintained table.

## Browser tools, nothing to install

- [Payday Super receipt-evidence example](https://duguid.com.au/tools/payday-super/): fixed synthetic $120 contribution, timely remittance and no recorded fund receipt. The pinned 0.1.3 engine returns AT_RISK with a 17 August 2026 deadline. No installation, uploads, or recalculation; source and full evaluation links are on the page.
- [Tools](https://duguid.com.au/tools/): index of eleven open-source accounting controls grouped by extract, calculate, control, and inspect, with delivery types, source repositories, and human-review boundaries.
- [Coal LSL levy calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/coal-lsl-levy/): answers which wages are eligible for the 2.7 per cent payroll levy under section 3B of the Coal Mining Industry (Long Service Leave) Payroll Levy Collection Act 1992, across the base-rate, annual-salary, and casual branches. Also lists eight questions the Act, the Regulations, and the guidance note leave unanswered.

## Tool guides, open source, install and run locally

- [Monthly Close Controls](https://duguid.com.au/tools/monthly-close-controls/): compares current and prior Xero-shaped trial balance CSVs and prepares an exception report for human review. The pinned fabricated example returns REVIEW with eight exceptions and six draft client queries. It reads local files and cannot approve a close.

- [Workpaper Review Gate](https://duguid.com.au/tools/workpaper-review-gate/): local readiness gate for BAS, month-end, and year-end folders. A missing artefact or unbalanced trial balance is sent back to the preparer. READY is not sign-off.
- [Xero trial balance CSV export](https://duguid.com.au/tools/xero-trial-balance/): pulls the trial balance from the Xero reporting API and refuses to write a file unless the month movement and the year-to-date figures both balance. Read-only scope.
- [ATO small business benchmark comparison](https://duguid.com.au/tools/ato-benchmarks/): maps a profit and loss to the ATO benchmark categories and shows whether each ratio falls inside the published range. Runs offline with no network call.
- [Construction WIP schedule](https://duguid.com.au/tools/wip-schedule/): deterministic AASB 15 cost-to-cost WIP from a contract CSV. Contract assets and liabilities are per contract and never netted. Review aid, not a determination.
- [Subcontract ledger skills for construction and mining](https://duguid.com.au/tools/subcontractor-ledgers/): agent skills for progress claims, retentions, work in progress under AASB 15, fuel tax credits, the Coal LSL levy, and payroll tax on contractors. Needs an AI coding agent to run. The skills assemble the contract CSV; TheWIPTally computes the schedule.
- [Section 100A and Division 6 trust distributions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/trust-distributions/): classifies a distribution against the PCG 2022/2 zones, which are white, green, and red only, works out proportionate Division 6 shares following Bamford, and calculates a section 99B amount.
- [Company tax rate and franking account](https://duguid.com.au/tools/company-tax-franking/): base rate entity test, franking account ledger, franking deficit tax, and the Division 203 benchmark rule.

## Refusals

- [What these tools refuse](https://duguid.com.au/tools/refusals/): each send-back and refusal the tools give, with the exact command output and exit code from fabricated fixtures at the released versions where a command exists, the llm-tax-guardrails (DrDebits) prompt-guide scenarios, and the human step that follows.

## Supported installation

- [Adopt](https://duguid.com.au/#adopt): the maintained source for the four supported adoption routes.
- [github-agent-skills](https://github.com/ryanduguid/github-agent-skills): github-agent-skills gives Codex and Claude Code the GitHub maintenance workflows this portfolio uses, and keeps the fabricated-data and human-review boundaries. Use the maintained setup at Adopt.

## Source code

- [Australian Accounting](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting): maintained home for the local MCP application and the independently versioned Australian accounting engines.
- [Accounting Review Pipeline](https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline): maintained home for Xero exports, readiness and close-review controls, the Excel toolkit and the Power BI project. Each component keeps its own distribution, commands, and licence.
- [Australian Accounting Skills](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills): release v0.2.1 contains nineteen workflows: nine public-practice and ten construction and mining subcontractor workflows. The default branch prepares v0.3.0 with fifty skills; its 31 additions have no recorded model evaluation. Use Adopt for installation. The contracting workflows are included in this unified pack.
- [llm-tax-guardrails](https://github.com/ryanduguid/llm-tax-guardrails): home of the DrDebits guide, APES 110 and TPB guardrails, refusal scenarios, and recorded model evaluations. An authorised human remains responsible for professional judgements and actions.
- [github.com/ryanduguid](https://github.com/ryanduguid): every tool on this site, plus the MCP server, the Claude Code skills, the Excel LAMBDA library, and the Power Query utilities.
- [Related resources](https://duguid.com.au/tools/#related-resources): third-party libraries, ATO guidance, and Commonwealth legislation sources this work depends on or sits beside.

## Optional

- [Crawler policy](https://duguid.com.au/robots.txt): search and user-requested citation fetches remain allowed, including Google-Extended. Common Crawl (CCBot) and Bytespider may crawl for open-web archival and training. GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Applebot-Extended, Amazonbot, cohere-ai, Diffbot, FacebookBot, and meta-externalagent remain blocked. Permission does not guarantee a crawl, dataset inclusion, or use by a model.

- [Australian tax legislation corpus](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-tax-legislation-corpus): Commonwealth tax legislation prepared for retrieval.
- [Release policy](https://github.com/ryanduguid/release-policy): the shared release workflow every repository above uses.
- [Full text of every page](https://duguid.com.au/llms-full.txt): every indexable page as plain text in sitemap order, built from the visible page content for one-fetch reading.
